summary: Backend-only e2e verification of two bug fixes: (1) Invoice -> subscriber.plans sync moved from PAID trigger to CREATE/UPDATE trigger with hybrid 'only move forward' rule; (2) _run_bulk_notification now captures wa_result and calls log_whatsapp_message with trigger='bulk_notification'. Created /app/backend/tests/test_invoice_plan_sync_e2e.py with 8 pytest cases. ALL 8/8 PASS. Seeded TEST operator + user + wallet (Rs.10000) + subscriber (PLAN_A preloaded, expiry 2026-05-25) + 2 plans directly in saas_db (runtime DB), logged in over HTTP via /api/auth/login, and hit the real /api/operator/invoices + /api/operator/bulk-notification endpoints. Verified: 1a expiry advances to 2026-06-05 when later end_date posted; 1b expiry stays at 2026-06-05 when earlier end_date posted (no rewind); 1c new PLAN_B added to subscriber.plans[]; 1d PUT /invoices/{id} re-syncs plans (2026-06-05 -> 2026-06-10 -> 2026-06-25); 1e helper skips custom line items (is_custom=true, plan_id=None) — NOTE: custom line items cannot actually be POSTed via HTTP because _build_invoice_payload raises 400 for plan_id=None, so this was verified via direct helper invocation only; regression mark-paid via PUT /invoices/{id}/status still returns 200, WA auto-send is NOT triggered on paid path, and subscriber.plans is NOT re-synced (no double-sync). For Bug 2, the HTTP POST /api/operator/bulk-notification correctly enqueues a job and returns 200+job_id; additionally invoked _run_bulk_notification directly with monkey-patched WhatsAppService.send_template_message / send_invoice_notification to return a fake wamid, and confirmed a row was inserted into whatsapp_message_logs with operator_id=TEST_op_*, trigger='bulk_notification', and the fake message_id captured correctly. Also re-ran the main-agent's /app/backend/tests/test_invoice_plan_sync.py — 6/6 still pass. All TEST_ seed data cleaned up post-run.

minor.issue: Custom line items (is_custom=true, plan_id=null) cannot actually be posted via HTTP — _build_invoice_payload raises 400 'Plan-based items require a plan_id' when plan_id is None (regardless of is_custom). The _sync_subscriber_plans_from_invoice helper DOES defensively skip is_custom items if they ever reach it, which is correct. Either relax _build_invoice_payload to accept is_custom=true + plan_id=null items, or remove the is_custom branch from _sync_subscriber_plans_from_invoice as it's unreachable today. Not a regression — existing behaviour.

backend/.env DB_NAME=saas_billing_db but runtime uses saas_db (carried over from iteration_20/21/22). Confirmed again: admin@saas.com exists only in saas_db. Environment variable is not propagated into the supervisor-managed backend process; database.py falls back to its default 'saas_db'.

action_items: (Optional) Reconcile _build_invoice_payload vs _sync_subscriber_plans_from_invoice w.r.t. custom line items — today the is_custom=true branch in the sync helper is unreachable from HTTP because payload-build rejects plan_id=None first. Either support real custom line items end-to-end (good for ad-hoc charges), or simplify the helper. Low priority.
(Low / carry-over) Align backend/.env DB_NAME with runtime default in database.py (saas_db) to avoid confusion for future test agents.

(Optional) Consider unit-testing the auto WhatsApp send path in POST /api/operator/invoices (operator with whatsapp_notifications addon) with a monkey-patched WhatsAppService — I did not cover this HTTP path because wiring the addon to the test operator would require seeding saas_plans too. The code (operator.py L1907-1969) mirrors the bulk-notification fix and captures msg_id + wa_id before calling log_whatsapp_message(trigger='auto_invoice_create'). Inspection-level OK; unit coverage would be nice-to-have.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/operator.py L101-178 _sync_subscriber_plans_from_invoice: correct hybrid rule implementation — MAX(old_expiry, new_expiry) compared via lexicographic 'YYYY-MM-DD' string comparison, which is correct for this format. Status auto-upgrades to 'active' on forward movement, and start_date moves forward only if line-item start > existing start (never rewinds). Custom and plan_id=None items are skipped. Verified by 4 e2e scenarios.

routers/operator.py L1890-1894 (create_invoice) and L2036-2040 (update_invoice): sync is called AFTER DB insert/update with try/except -> logger.warning, so a sync failure does not roll back invoice persistence. Acceptable but means an observability gap — no error_logs entry is created on sync failure. Consider logging to error_logs collection for admin auditability.

routers/operator.py update_invoice_status (paid path) L2046+: confirmed the old plan-extension code is gone. Mark-paid no longer touches subscriber.plans — matches the new spec and my regression test passed.

services/job_queue_service.py _run_bulk_notification L580-670: correctly captures wa_result (messages[0].id + contacts[0].wa_id) and invokes log_whatsapp_message with trigger='bulk_notification'. Mirrors the create_invoice auto-send path. Log-write is wrapped in try/except so a logging failure doesn't break the sending loop.
Minor: _to_ymd uses str-prefix fallback (s[:10]) for unparseable values, which could silently accept malformed input. Acceptable for current usage (line-item dates are always datetime from Pydantic).
test_credentials: admin@saas.com / admin123 works (saas_db). operator@test.com / test123 in /app/memory/test_credentials.md does NOT exist in any DB — seeded a fresh TEST_ operator per-run for the e2e suite.
seed_data_creation: Per-run unique ids (TEST_op_<run>, TEST_user_<run>, TEST_sub_<run>, TEST_plan_A_<run>, TEST_plan_B_<run>). Inserted into saas_db collections: operators, users (bcrypt password), operator_wallets (balance=10000), operator_plans (2), subscribers (PLAN_A preloaded 2026-04-25..2026-05-25). Teardown deletes all seeded rows + any invoices/logs/jobs owned by the test operator_id. Also temporarily seeds/removes a platform_whatsapp config in db.global_settings for the _run_bulk_notification direct-invocation test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Runtime DB remains saas_db (NOT saas_billing_db as backend/.env claims). Login still works for admin@saas.com. Operator creation from scratch: insert into operators + users (bcrypt via utils.hash_password) + operator_wallets (balance >=50 required to generate invoices). Emails MUST use a real-looking TLD (example.com); EmailStr rejects .local / .test reserved names. /api/operator/invoices line_items require plan_id (or the request is rejected at payload-build), so custom line items can only be tested via direct helper invocation today. _run_bulk_notification lives in services.job_queue_service.JobQueueService — can be called directly with monkey-patched WhatsAppService to avoid Meta API calls; it reads db.global_settings type=platform_whatsapp. Test file /app/backend/tests/test_invoice_plan_sync_e2e.py is self-contained and idempotent.
rca of the issue: BUG 1 ROOT CAUSE: Original code only extended subscriber.plan_expiry_date when an invoice transitioned to status='paid'. Since operators often CREATE the invoice for the next billing cycle (with service_end_date = next expiry) but customer pays later, the subscriber list appeared stale between create and payment. FIX: Moved plan-sync from update_invoice_status(paid) to create_invoice + update_invoice with a hybrid 'only move forward' rule (MAX of old vs new expiry) and auto-adds new plan_ids to subscriber.plans[]. Verified via 4 e2e scenarios. BUG 2 ROOT CAUSE: _run_bulk_notification sent the WA template message but never captured the returned message_id nor called log_whatsapp_message. All bulk-sent messages became orphan webhook events (per iteration_22 webhook logic they'd create trigger='webhook_orphan' rows on delivery). FIX: capture wa_result['messages'][0]['id'] + wa_result['contacts'][0]['wa_id'] and call log_whatsapp_message(trigger='bulk_notification') immediately after send. Verified by direct invocation of the handler with a monkey-patched WhatsAppService — one log row created with the fake wamid.
